description_en: Queries one or more block storage cloud disks that you have created
description_zh: 查询一块或多块您已经创建的块存储云盘
name: DescribeLensMonitorDisks

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call DescribeRegions to query the list of regions supported by EBS Lens
parameters.help_zh: 地域 ID。您可以调用 DescribeRegions 查询块存储数据洞察支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The list of cloud disk IDs
parameters.name: disk_ids

parameters.help_en:
The cloud disk type. Valid values:

cloud: basic cloud disk.
cloud_efficiency: ultra cloud disk.
cloud_ssd: standard SSD.
cloud_essd: ESSD.
cloud_auto: ESSD AutoPL cloud disk.
cloud_essd_entry: ESSD Entry cloud disk
parameters.help_zh:
云盘类型。取值范围：

cloud：普通云盘。
cloud_efficiency：高效云盘。
cloud_ssd：SSD 盘。
cloud_essd：ESSD 云盘。
cloud_auto：ESSD AutoPL 云盘。
cloud_essd_entry：ESSD Entry 云盘
parameters.name: disk_category

parameters.help_en:
The list of cloud disk event tags. This parameter is used to filter cloud disks that have experienced these event types within the last 24 hours. Valid values:
NoSnapshot: data protection.
BurstIOTriggered: burst I/O.
CostOptimizationNeeded: cost optimization.
DiskSpecNotMatchedWithInstance: instance and cloud disk specifications do not match.
DiskIONo4kAligned: non-4K aligned read/write.
DiskIOHang: IOHang occurred on the cloud disk.
InstanceIOPSExceedInstanceMaxLimit: instance IOPS reached the upper limit.
InstanceBPSExceedInstanceMaxLimit: instance BPS reached the upper limit.
DiskIOPSExceedInstanceMaxLimit: cloud disk IOPS reached the instance upper limit.
DiskBPSExceedInstanceMaxLimit: cloud disk BPS reached the instance upper limit.
DiskIOPSExceedDiskMaxLimit: cloud disk IOPS reached the disk upper limit.
DiskBPSExceedDiskMaxLimit: cloud disk BPS reached the disk upper limit
parameters.help_zh:
云盘事件标签列表，用于筛选24小时内发生过这些事件类型的云盘。取值范围：
NoSnapshot：数据保护
BurstIOTriggered：突发IO
CostOptimizationNeeded：成本优化
DiskSpecNotMatchedWithInstance：实例与云盘规格不匹配
DiskIONo4kAligned：非4K对齐读写
DiskIOHang：云盘有IOHang发生
InstanceIOPSExceedInstanceMaxLimit：实例IOPS到达上限
InstanceBPSExceedInstanceMaxLimit：实例BPS到达上限
DiskIOPSExceedInstanceMaxLimit：云盘IOPS到达实例上限
DiskBPSExceedInstanceMaxLimit：云盘BPS到达实例上限
DiskIOPSExceedDiskMaxLimit：云盘IOPS到达磁盘上限
DiskBPSExceedDiskMaxLimit：云盘BPS到达磁盘上限
parameters.name: lens_tags

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次 API 调用返回的NextToken参数值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page for paging queries. Maximum value: 100.
Default value:

The default value is 10.

If the value is set to greater than 100, the default value is 100
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页行数。最大值为 100。
默认值：

默认值为 10。

当设置的值大于 100 时，默认值为 100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The regular expression pattern used for fuzzy match filtering of cloud disk IDs
parameters.help_zh: 正则匹配模糊查询筛选云盘ID
parameters.name: disk_id_pattern
